headline: GTD and Grupo Romero Plan Up to $17M Investment in Peruvian Data Centers
summary: GTD plans to invest between $6 million and $7 million to expand a second data center hall in Lurín with Grupo Romero, as part of wider local investments totaling up to $17 million.
why: Data center expansions by regional telecom and investment groups support growing enterprise cloud adoption and digital infrastructure demand.
